subject: mathematics_2a
question_text: If 1, 2, 3 and 4 are the roots of x⁴ + ax³ + bx² + cx + d = 0, then find the values of a, b, c and d.

recall_prompt: Say how each of a, b, c, d comes from the roots, and which ones carry a minus sign.
insider_note: The signs alternate −, +, −, +; students who write all four positive lose both marks at once.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Root relations
steps.margin_note: First mark. For a monic quartic, a = −S₁, b = S₂, c = −S₃, d = S₄ (signs alternate). S₁ = 10 and S₂ has six products.
lines: For a monic quartic with roots α, β, γ, δ:
a = −S₁, b = S₂, c = −S₃, d = S₄

recall.must_convey: That the coefficients are the root sums with alternating signs (a = −S₁, b = S₂, c = −S₃, d = S₄), and that S₁ = 10 and S₂ = 35.
accept: a is minus the sum of the roots, b is the sum of the products in pairs, c is minus the sum of products in threes, d is the product, so a is minus ten and b is thirty five
the signs alternate, sum ten gives a equals minus ten, six pairwise products add to thirty five
use S one S two S three S four with alternating signs
a minus S one, b S two, signs alternate, a minus ten b thirty five
a equals minus ten and b equals thirty five from the sum and the pairwise sum

steps.why: Expanding (x − α)(x − β)(x − γ)(x − δ) gives x⁴ − S₁x³ + S₂x² − S₃x + S₄; the signs alternate because each factor contributes a −root. Four roots make six pairs, and all six must be listed.
common_mistakes: Writing a = +10 (a is MINUS the sum).
Missing one of the six pairwise products; with four roots there are ⁴C₂ = 6.

steps.label: Find c and d
steps.margin_note: Second mark. S₃ has four triple products (leave one root out each time), S₄ is the single product 24. c = −S₃, d = S₄. Check: (x − 1)(x − 2)(x − 3)(x − 4) expands to the same.

recall.must_convey: That S₃ = 50 gives c = −50 and S₄ = 24 gives d = 24, so a = −10, b = 35, c = −50, d = 24.
accept: the products in threes add to fifty so c is minus fifty and the product of all four is twenty four so d is twenty four
a minus ten b thirty five c minus fifty d twenty four
c is minus S three which is minus fifty and d is S four which is twenty four
S three fifty kabatti c minus fifty, S four twenty four kabatti d twenty four
the four values are minus ten, thirty five, minus fifty and twenty four

steps.why: c carries the minus because S₃ enters with a minus; d does not because S₄ enters with a plus. Expanding (x − 1)(x − 2)(x − 3)(x − 4) directly gives x⁴ − 10x³ + 35x² − 50x + 24, the same four numbers.
common_mistakes: Missing one of the four triple products (leave each root out once: 24, 12, 8, 6).
Writing d = −24 by continuing the alternation one step too far.
